data_issues: The unit (row) order in test.npz is permuted relative to train/val: per-unit firing-rate statistics do not line up with the training units under the identity order (Hungarian matching cost 23.4 for identity vs 1.7 for the best permutation; train vs val is essentially identity). A train-fitted decoder applied directly to test would be invalid. I recovered the unit mapping by matching per-unit mean temporal profiles, variance, and responsiveness (refined with class-conditional profiles); test column perm[i] corresponds to training unit i, perm=[20, 19, 7, 1, 8, 6, 5, 22, 24, 12, 14, 11, 0, 4, 23, 15, 16, 17, 25, 2, 26, 9, 3, 21, 18, 13, 10, 27]. Low-rate units may be matched with some ambiguity. Labels and image_id are consistent; no duplicate trials across splits.
